reading: The sketch is a festival landing-page hero: a flex nav bar, a tilted pink-to-indigo gradient cut-out shape behind the content, three tilted scrolling marquee rows (solid "NOISE...", hollow-outline "MORE...", and a black band "THREE DAYS...40 ACTS..."), a spinning ring of small "TICKETS ON SALE" text around a circle, a body paragraph, and a white pill CTA button with a hard offset shadow — all specified precisely by the typed notes.
